name: it-reelsmaker
description: Edit vertical short videos (Reels, Shorts, TikTok) from talking-head footage in Claude Code: cut pauses and retakes by audio, virtual camera and on-brand motion graphics in Remotion, designed scenes for hooks, quotes, numbers and calls to action, word-timed subtitles, face-aware layout, loudness mastering and a 1080×1920 render. Brand profiles with a brand tone. Runs locally with ffmpeg, Node.js and Python.

project_root.title: Editing project folder
project_root.description: Folder where edits live: edit/<id>/ per video, brands/<slug>/ brand profiles. Leave empty to set it in the first session.

remotion_dir.title: Remotion project
remotion_dir.description: Remotion project used for camera, graphics, subtitles and render, for example <project>/reels. Leave empty to create or pick it in the first session.

assets_dir.title: Asset library (optional)
assets_dir.description: Your own library of sound effects, music, icons and memes. Leave empty if you don't have one.

face_model.title: YuNet face model (optional)
face_model.description: Path to face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx for face-aware layout. Leave empty to place text by looking at frames instead.
